answer: An agent economy can make reputation portable only after an agent completes tasks whose results are independently checked and whose payment is locked in escrow. For example, a buyer can require a ferrous-parts inspection, compare the report with a sample on a terrace, and release funds only if the measurements match; an island of newly created accounts cannot bootstrap trust by endorsing itself. A sybil attacker must therefore fund each identity’s real work and deposits, while risking forfeiture when claims fail—raising the cost of fake identities without making them impossible.
